title: Components after conditional expectation
statement: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces with strictly positive atom masses, let $J,S$ be subsets of its coordinate set, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the product outcome space. At every outcome $x$, the $S$-component of the conditional expectation of $f$ given the coordinates in $J$ equals the $S$-component of $f$ if $S\subseteq J$, and equals zero otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a product of finite probability spaces
each coordinate atom has strictly positive mass
$J,S$ are subsets of the coordinate set
$f$ is real-valued on the product outcome space
replaced: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces with strictly positive atom masses and outcome space $\Omega=\prod_i\Omega_i$, $J,S\subseteq[n]$, and $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. The $S$-component of $E_Jf$ equals $f_S$ when $S\subseteq J$, and zero otherwise.
